title: Security guard in Quezon killed by co-worker he reprimanded over cellphone use
summary: A security guard on a motorcycle was shot dead by two motorcycle-riding suspects along Maharlika Highway in Barangay Lagalag, Tiaong, Quezon, on Saturday afternoon.
